# Clustering taxa for network analysis with WGCNA

The goal for this analysis was to use WGCNA to get representative modules of group of taxa that "act" similarly. This is meant to simplify the data for metabolite networks.

## 1. Data preparation

library(tidyr)

### Import data

Rarefied data was imported and a phyloseq object was a created. Taxa were summed at the genus level for clustering analysis. 
 
```{r warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}
data<-read.csv("Bacteria_table.csv", row.names=1, header=TRUE)

metadata<-read.csv("BSS_metadata update10FEB2025.csv", row.names=1, header=TRUE)
metadata<-as.data.frame(t(metadata))
metadata[, c("ATCCMSA2002control_P1","ATCCMSA2002control_P2","NegativeControl","NegativeControl_P2")] <- NULL
metadata<-as.data.frame(t(metadata))

metadata$Age<-as.numeric(metadata$Age)
metadata$Day.of.sample.relative.to.BSS.administration<-as.numeric(metadata$Day.of.sample.relative.to.BSS.administration)
metadata$Day<-as.numeric(metadata$Day)
metadata$Calculated.BMI<-as.numeric(metadata$Calculated.BMI)
metadata$Days_colonoscopy_bl<-as.numeric(metadata$Days_colonoscopy_bl)
metadata$Days_colonoscopy_day0<-as.numeric(metadata$Days_colonoscopy_day0)


taxa <- data[, c("kingdom","phylum","class","order","family","genus","species","OTU")]
data[, c("kingdom","phylum","class","order","family","genus","species","OTU","ATCCMSA2002control_P1","ATCCMSA2002control_P2","NegativeControl","NegativeControl_P2")] <- NULL

otu<-otu_table(data, taxa_are_rows=TRUE)
meta<-sample_data(metadata)
tax<-tax_table(as.matrix(taxa))
dada2_rare_0<-phyloseq(otu, meta, tax)


```


## 2. WGCNA

WGCNA was used to cluster rarefied (normalized) abundances all genera from all samples. 

```{r}

genus<-tax_glom(dada2_rare_0, "genus")
rarefied<-phyloseq_to_df(genus, addtax=T)
rownames(rarefied)<-rarefied[,"genus"]
rarefied[, c("kingdom","phylum","class","order","family","genus","species","OTU","OTU.1")] <- NULL


```

### Calculating power threshold

```{r warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}

DAA <- as.data.frame(t(rarefied))


## tutorials suggest removing outlier samples. To look for these, the code hashed out below is for clustering samples. I did not remove any samples becaues I don't think if that's appropriate for this study and not all "outliers" are coming from one person. Also there were strong differences in response and I don't want to lose that resolution.

powers = c(c(1:20), seq(from = 22, to=30, by=2))

sft = pickSoftThreshold(DAA, powerVector = powers, verbose = 5) 
#Scale-free topology fit index as a function of the soft-thresholding power



```

```{r}
par(mfrow = c(1,2));
cex1 = 0.9;
plot(sft$fitIndices[,1], -sign(sft$fitIndices[,3])*sft$fitIndices[,2],
     xlab="Soft Threshold (power)",ylab="Scale Free Topology Model Fit,signed R^2",type="n",
     main = paste("Scale independence")); text(sft$fitIndices[,1], -sign(sft$fitIndices[,3])*sft$fitIndices[,2],labels=powers,cex=cex1,col="red"); abline(h=0.90,col="red") 

```

```{r}
# Mean connectivity as a function of the soft-thresholding power
plot(sft$fitIndices[,1], sft$fitIndices[,5],
     xlab="Soft Threshold (power)",ylab="Mean Connectivity", type="n",
     main = paste("Mean connectivity")); text(sft$fitIndices[,1], sft$fitIndices[,5], labels=powers, cex=cex1,col="red")
```

<br>

>Notes: For power threshold, choosing 7. 

<br>

```{r message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, results=FALSE}

picked_power = 7
temp_cor <- cor       
cor <- WGCNA::cor         
netwk <- blockwiseModules(DAA,
                          power = picked_power,              
                          networkType = "unsigned",

                          # == Tree and Block Options ==
                          deepSplit = 2,
                          pamRespectsDendro = F,
                          minModuleSize = 10,
                          maxBlockSize = 4000,
                          saveTOMs = T,
                          saveTOMFileBase = "ER",
                          numericLabels = T,
                          verbose = 3)

```

```{r}

mergedColors = labels2colors(netwk$colors)
# Plot the dendrogram and the module colors underneath
plotDendroAndColors(
  netwk$dendrograms[[1]],
  mergedColors[netwk$blockGenes[[1]]],
  "Module colors",
  dendroLabels = FALSE,
  hang = 0.03,
  addGuide = TRUE,
  guideHang = 0.05 )



```

<br><br>

```{r}

module_df <- data.frame(
  genus= names(netwk$colors),
  colors = labels2colors(netwk$colors),
  MEs = netwk$colors
)


```

<br>

#### Eigengenes

Listed how many modules (eigengenes) have been generated and determined the differences between the abundances of the eigengenes at different time points to determine which ones to focus in on related to the response at day2. 

```{r}

table(netwk$colors)

```

<br>


>Notes: There are 25 modules for these samples. 

<br><br> 


```{r}


MEs0 = moduleEigengenes(DAA, netwk$colors)$eigengenes
MEs0$Sample<-rownames(MEs0)

kable(MEs0, caption = "<strong>Table X. Genus eigengenes. <strong>") %>%
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped")) %>% 
  scroll_box(width = "750px", height="650px", fixed_thead=T) 

library(downloadthis)
MEs0 %>%
  download_this(
    output_name = "Genus eigengenes",
    output_extension = ".xlsx",
    button_label = "Download results in excel",
    button_type = "default",
    has_icon = TRUE,
    icon = "fa fa-save"
  )


```


<br>

>**Notes:** ME0 represents all the other taxa that didn't cluster, should not be included as an eigengene. 

<br>


```{r}

#genus<-tax_glom(dada2_rare_0, "genus")
rarefied<-phyloseq_to_df(genus, addtax=T)
taxa<-rarefied[,c("kingdom","phylum","class","order","family","genus")]
taxa$OTU<-taxa$genus
rownames(taxa)<-taxa$genus
taxa[,"genus"]<-NULL

rownames(rarefied)<-rarefied[,"genus"]
rarefied[, c("kingdom","phylum","class","order","family","genus","species","OTU","OTU.1")] <- NULL

otu<-otu_table(rarefied, taxa_are_rows=T)

tax<-tax_table(as.matrix(taxa))

genus_new<-phyloseq(otu, meta, tax)


taxa_sum<-data.frame(taxa_sums(genus_new))
taxa_sum$x.genus<-rownames(taxa_sum)

```

#### Stats for modules by timepoint


```{r warning=FALSE, message=FALSE, results='asis'}

MEs0$Sample<-rownames(MEs0)
MEs<-merge.data.frame(MEs0, metadata, by="Sample", all.x=TRUE, all.y=TRUE)

t_results = {}

gene_names<-colnames(MEs[,c(2:26)])

# comparing Day 0 to Day 2 with both responders and non-responders 


for (i in gene_names) {
  aov <- aov(MEs[[i]]~Timepoint, data=MEs)
  tukey<- TukeyHSD(aov)
  df_tukey<-data.frame(tukey$Timepoint)

  df_tukey$comp<-rownames(df_tukey)

  df_tukey <- df_tukey %>% separate_wider_delim(comp, "-", names = c("group1", "group2"))

  df_tukey[1]<-i
  
  df_tukey<-dplyr::select(df_tukey, c(1,5,6,4))
  
  t_results[[i]]<-df_tukey
}

x_list<-{}

for (i in gene_names) {

x<- kable(t_results[[i]], caption="<strong>Table X. Results from ANOVA + Tukey test for multiple comparisons of eigengenes between timepoint.<strong>", format="html", full_width = FALSE, table.attr= "style='width:80%;'")
  
y<-kable_styling(x, position="left", bootstrap_options = c("striped"))%>%
   column_spec(4, color=ifelse(t_results[[i]][,4] < 0.05, "green","black"))%>% 
  scroll_box(height="350px", fixed_thead=T) 

x_list[[i]]<-y
  
}

```

```{r, results='asis'}
for (name in names(x_list)) {
  cat("##", name, "\n")
  print(x_list[[name]])
  cat("\n\n")
}

```


```{r}
sixteen<-module_df %>% filter(MEs == 16)
twentyfour<-module_df %>% filter(MEs == 24)
one<-module_df %>% filter(MEs ==1)
two<-module_df %>% filter(MEs ==2)
three<-module_df %>% filter(MEs ==3)
twenty<-module_df %>% filter(MEs ==20)
twentyone<-module_df %>% filter(MEs ==21)

```


<br><br>

>**Notes:** The abundances of these modules (MEs) were compared between time points. The MEs that have significant difference between day2 and other time points (namely day 0) are module 1, 2, 3, 16, 20, 21, 24. Those were further examined to identify which features are "most important" to that module. The factors that were considered were significant correlation to the ME and abundance. Abundance taking more priority rather than higher correlation. The results are below for each.

## 3. Definitions of modules 

### ME1 


```{r}

rarefied$genus<-rownames(rarefied) 

one2<-merge.data.frame(one, rarefied, by="genus", all.x=TRUE, all.y=FALSE)
one2<-one2 %>% mutate_at(4:127, as.numeric)


rownames(one2)<-one2$genus
one2[,c(1:3)]<-NULL

one2<-as.data.frame(t(one2))
one2$Sample<-rownames(one2)

MEs_abund<- merge.data.frame(one2, MEs0, by="Sample", all.x=TRUE, all.y=TRUE)

rownames(MEs_abund)<-MEs_abund$Sample
MEs_abund[,"Sample"]<-NULL




x<-data.frame(cor(MEs_abund))
x$genus<-rownames(x)

testRes = cor.mtest(MEs_abund, conf.level = 0.95)
p<-data.frame(testRes$p)


y<-data.frame(x$genus, x$ME2,p$ME2)
names(y)[1]<-"genus"

taxa_sum$genus<-rownames(taxa_sum)

z<-merge.data.frame(y, taxa_sum, by="genus", all.x=TRUE, all=FALSE)
taxa$genus<-taxa$OTU
a<-merge.data.frame(z, taxa, by="genus", all.x=TRUE, all.y=FALSE)

a <- data.frame(a[order(a$taxa_sums.genus_new., decreasing=TRUE), ])
a[,"x.genus"]<-NULL

names(a)[2]<-"R2"
names(a)[3]<-"p value"
names(a)[4]<-"Total abundance"
kable(a, caption = "<strong>Table X. Info on genera in ME1.<strong>") %>%
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped")) %>%
  scroll_box(width = "750px", height="650px", fixed_thead=T)
```

<br>

>**Notes:** Eigengene defined by Vescimonas, Anaerotruncus and Eubacterium. They are all Eubacteriales. 

-------------

<br><br>

### ME2

```{r}

rarefied$genus<-rownames(rarefied) 

two2<-merge.data.frame(two, rarefied, by="genus", all.x=TRUE, all.y=FALSE)
two2<-two2 %>% mutate_at(4:127, as.numeric)


rownames(two2)<-two2$genus
two2[,c(1:3)]<-NULL

two2<-as.data.frame(t(two2))
two2$Sample<-rownames(two2)

MEs_abund<- merge.data.frame(two2, MEs0, by="Sample", all.x=TRUE, all.y=TRUE)

rownames(MEs_abund)<-MEs_abund$Sample
MEs_abund[,"Sample"]<-NULL

x<-data.frame(cor(MEs_abund, method="spearman"))
x$genus<-rownames(x)

testRes = cor.mtest(MEs_abund, conf.level = 0.95)
p<-data.frame(testRes$p)


y<-data.frame(x$genus, x$ME2,p$ME2)

names(y)[1]<-"genus"

taxa_sum$genus<-rownames(taxa_sum)

z<-merge.data.frame(y, taxa_sum, by="genus", all.x=TRUE, all=FALSE)
taxa$genus<-taxa$OTU
a<-merge.data.frame(z, taxa, by="genus", all.x=TRUE, all.y=FALSE)

a <- data.frame(a[order(a$taxa_sums.genus_new., decreasing=TRUE), ])
a[,"x.genus"]<-NULL


names(a)[2]<-"R2"
names(a)[3]<-"p value"
names(a)[4]<-"Total abundance"
kable(a, caption = "<strong>Table X. Info on genera in ME2.<strong>") %>%
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped")) %>%
  scroll_box(width = "750px", height="650px", fixed_thead=T)
```

<br>

>**Notes:** Eigengene defined by Anaerobutyricum and Haemophilus.

<br><br>
